scope: Read-only engineering disposition using existing geometry, functional groups, public documentation, saved current-client code and existing-job response bodies. No geometry generation, source edit, native inventory, cloud configuration change or new job.

physical_domain_disposition.front_height: Reuse the qualified common below-gap class for eligible fitted F movers. L1 and X6 remain fixed; do not resurrect the old tall-mover population.
physical_domain_disposition.regions: Use actual on-board F regions with reviewed associations, not off-board grouping regions to enforce side. Multiple assigned regions form a union.
physical_domain_disposition.body_boundary: The placement guide describes fitting components and required clearances inside regions. Exact physical-body/courtyard/origin and rotation semantics remain unobserved. Do not invent per-origin erosions, double-apply body margins or generate many tiny regions before resolving that distinction.
physical_domain_disposition.fixed_obstacles: Carry source-bound J1/J2/X6 planning reservations, R3.2 mount domains and retained-copper/private-path guards. J2 already includes its0.7mm allowance. F body placement, B contact metal and through-via exclusions are different obligations.
physical_domain_disposition.access_limits: Existing proxies do not qualify complete harness, tool or loaded-contact envelopes. Keep those limits explicit and require exact full-assembly rebinding before acceptance.
physical_domain_disposition.electrical_limits: Membership in a functional group is not a pin-relative distance, return-path, quiet-zone or timing constraint. Do not freeze the old floorplan merely because a relative constraint is missing.

evidence.ecad_definition_limit: Empty old-job ECAD definitions provide no positive placement or geometry evidence.
evidence.capture_limit: Browser export to the private directory was denied by its allowed-root policy. Response-only files were instead saved under ignored .playwright-mcp and copied to the authorized evidence directory. No headers, tokens or raw browser payloads are committed.

custom_component_proximity.evidence_level: Observed client implementation and existing-job schema; no added, saved, compiled or routed constraint.
custom_component_proximity.client_help: Best-effort child-component placement near a specified parent pin, with a PRC for final pin-to-pin distance. Child components should be the smaller ones. Do not duplicate bypass-capacitor relationships here.
custom_component_proximity.important_limit: No explicit child-pin field. Proximity is not a hard allowed region, routed-path length, ground-return qualification or private/Kelvin topology guarantee.

timing_sensitive_signals.public_documentation: Still described as internal testing and not publicly available.
timing_sensitive_signals.observed_saved_schema: Editable component/pin pairs, max_skew, max_delay, pin_delay and signal_frequency; allowAdditions=true, zero entries.
timing_sensitive_signals.current_client: Contains initialization, optional-value and editing code for this category.
timing_sensitive_signals.disposition: Do not repeat categorical platform unavailability solely from public prose, but schema/client presence does not establish current-account availability, persistence, resistor-aware solving or route enforcement. No timing value was entered.

clock_gate.known_source_requirement: R6 remains1kohm in series; C2/C3 remain15pF and C3 remains on the crystal side of R6. This is existing source intent, not a new defect.
clock_gate.known_documentation_limit: The crystal comprehension says it does not detect or function with load-limiting resistors. The September27 bakeoff already recorded this limitation.
clock_gate.disposition: Do not bypass R6, mislabel a resistor terminal as an MCU pin, or treat a manually added crystal row as a demonstrated solution. Custom proximity is a possible placement aid only; no automatic new retention, MCU freeze, repair or manual routing.
clock_gate.next_bounded_item: Bind exact source clock terminals and component-relative exclusion/return obligations, then define a finite independent acceptance contract and assess legitimate proximity/timing representations. Reuse existing source evidence; do not invent numeric limits from UI defaults or launch another general inventory.

limitations: Neither the common physical placement domains nor exact capacitor-to-pin mappings are completed by this disposition.
Saved old-job schemas are not evidence that newly configured constraints persist, execute or cover the required electrical behavior.
No new full-board input, cloud object, upload, configuration edit, recompute, paid use, repair, integration or fabrication is released.
